output_target: prerequisite diagnostics and decision; no automatic piecewise decoder
observation_model: official Beat This 1.1.0 final0, CPU float32, 50 fps, four threads

reference_policy.real_boundary_metric: practical agreement with owner-reviewed maps; no independent millisecond certification
reference_policy.tier3_boundary_metric: unscored when audio origin is unresolved
reference_policy.constructed_metric: sample-coordinate error and continuous boundary error
reference_policy.oracle_clocks: rate and canonical quarter/bar phase only; support and boundary remain in evaluation-only files

candidate_metrics.primary_rate_target: nearest representable denominator-four rate; exact reference and representational error also retained
candidate_metrics.local_proposal_if_loss_observed: source-only windows can propose rates; their edges never define tempo changes

support_diagnostic.observations: source beat probabilities and weighted peaks on original timeline
support_diagnostic.calibration: general score/density distributions from constructed fixed controls; real change labels not used to choose parameters
support_diagnostic.sustained_support: report run lengths in seconds and quarters; no product minimum duration declared
support_diagnostic.phase_drift_policy: separate clock-phase contradiction from evidence for a different nominal rate

boundary_diagnostic.objective: compare neighboring clocks against original-time source evidence
boundary_diagnostic.oracle_phase_continuity: if used, report separately from audio-only objective and preserve ambiguity
